projects.title: Interactive Web-Based Photobooth App
projects.description: Built a React-based photobooth web application featuring real-time camera feed, countdown animation, and live filter previews using CSS filters and grain overlays. • Implemented a dynamic filmstrip UI that displays the last 20 shots with timestamped saves and a centered gallery view for user-friendly selection. • Integrated customizable photo filters (e.g., sepia, grayscale, hue-rotate) and grain textures to replicate nostalgic city-based aesthetic styles. • Added features such as extra-large animated countdowns, real-time saving, and enhanced user interactivity for an engaging UX. • Applied modular component design with Tailwind CSS and hooks-based state management to ensure scalability and responsiveness across devices.

projects.title: Interactive Audio Analysis & Sonification with Fourier Transforms
projects.description: Developed an interactive Jupyter-based system for analyzing and manipulating audio signals using Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) and spectrogram visualizations. • Implemented real-time pitch shifting, time scaling, and noise filtering on WAV audio files using Python libraries such as librosa, scipy, and matplotlib. • Engineered an STFT-based signal reconstruction pipeline with overlap-add synthesis to enable perceptually smooth time-domain signal restoration. • Built an exploratory interface allowing users to visualize frequency content and apply transformations to extract and manipulate musical or spoken components. • Demonstrated understanding of spectral filtering and phase reconstruction in practical DSP applications for audio engineering and multimedia research.

projects.title: LLM Probing for Code Semantics vs. Syntax Separation
projects.description: Investigating whether large language models disentangle code syntax and semantics in their hidden representations through contrastive probing and ranking-based objectives. • Built data pipelines using Leetcode-Rosetta and AST transformations to generate semantically similar but syntactically diverse (and vice versa) code pairs. • Engineered test case verifiers and prompt-based code generation utilities using Anthropic Claude API to create structured evaluation benchmarks. • Proposed a hybrid probing framework that projects hidden states into semantic and syntactic subspaces and evaluates dot-product similarity across curated code pairs. • Extended probing to token-level analysis and semantic ranking tasks using weak supervision (e.g., AST similarity, embedding distance). • Collaborating cross-functionally with research team members on probing design, model introspection, and COLM paper preparation (target submission: March 30, 2025).

projects.title: Correlated Edge Filtering in Distributed Learning for Bandwidth-Constrained Networks
projects.description: Developed a bandwidth-efficient distributed learning framework that reduces edge-to-server data transmission by 94% using autoencoder-based feature extraction and clustering. • Implemented gRPC-based communication between edge devices and a central server to support real-time sensor data streaming and aggregation. • Designed a semi-supervised learning loop where the server provides gradient-based feedback to refine edge clustering and feature selection. • Evaluated system on high-dimensional video datasets and demonstrated a 900x reduction in transmission volume without significant performance loss. • Contributed to both machine learning model development and visualization of spatial-temporal edge behavior under varying network constraints.

projects.title: ZON: AI-Powered Smart Calendar Assistant for Global Scheduling
projects.description: Developed an intelligent scheduling assistant ('ZON') to optimize global team coordination by integrating LLMs (via AWS Bedrock) with LangGraph, Google Calendar API, and EC2-based deployment. • Engineered conversational workflows using LangGraph for real-time dialogue state management and intent recognition, enabling personalized, timezone-aware scheduling suggestions. • Applied prompt engineering and JSON schema generation to dynamically interface with external calendar tools, streamlining resource allocation and reducing unnecessary communications. • Designed a scalable architecture using EC2 for deployment and OAuth 2.0 for secure user authentication and data integration. • Benchmarked against industry tools like Calendly and FindTime, highlighting enhanced personalization, global timezone handling, and automated multi-resource management.

projects.title: Hotel Sentiment Analysis
projects.description: The project focuses on understanding how customer feedback can significantly enhance the ability of hotels to address and pre-empt potential issues, thereby improving customer satisfaction. For instance, if a hotel consistently receives poor ratings in cleanliness, this feedback can be directly channeled into operational changes such as improving cleaning services or reevaluating the suppliers of cleaning materials. By predicting review ratings based on textual feedback, hotels can develop a predictive understanding of how certain services or operational changes might resonate with guests. This approach allows for proactive management of customer satisfaction, leading to improved reviews and, consequently, a better online reputation.

projects.title: Euchre
projects.description: A program including 4 cpp files to play the game of euchre. Card.cpp Pack.cpp Player.cpp Euchre.cpp Euchre (pronounced 'YOO-kur') is a trick-taking card game popular in Michigan. It is most commonly played by four people in two partnerships with a deck of 24 cards. Partnerships accumulate points for winning tricks, and the game continues until one side reaches the maximum number of points. Wrote a simulator for a game of Euchre with abstract data types, object-oriented programming, and polymorphism. • Write a simulator using C++ object-oriented programming for a game of Euchre can be played by either AI player or human player or both • Implement an AI computer-controlled player of euchre which can play this game automatically according to the rules I set • Implement human-controlled player which reads input from the human user

projects.title: Genomics Project with Machine Learning and SEI Framework
projects.description: Developed a comprehensive genomics analysis pipeline combining machine learning with the SEI (Sequence-Extraction-Inference) framework for disease classification using genetic sequence data and Short Tandem Repeat (STR) analysis. • Implemented bioinformatics preprocessing using bedtools for genomic interval manipulation, including merging, intersecting, and annotating genomic regions with functional data. • Built machine learning models for STR pattern recognition and classification, enabling automated identification of repetitive DNA sequences and allele length prediction. • Applied the SEI framework to predict sequence regulatory activities across 21,907 chromatin profiles and 40 sequence classes for comprehensive genomic analysis. • Developed Python-based data processing pipelines for high-dimensional genomic data, including dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP) and clustering algorithms (K-Means, Louvain). • Created automated workflows for variant effect prediction and sequence class analysis, supporting both hg19 and hg38 genome assemblies with CUDA acceleration capabilities.
